_comment: Feature labels shown on the pricing cards, the home page, the compare and
industry pages, Premium email, and the desktop app's upgrade modal.
Keep each label under ~45 characters. The desktop app renders them in a
fixed 340px plan card whose TextBlock has no TextWrapping set, so longer
strings are clipped there even though the website wraps them fine.
{placeholder} tokens are substituted from config/pricing.php in
get_plan_features(), and work in 'label' as well as the optional 'detail'.
Numbers are written into the sentence rather than tacked on as a detail so
the lines read as benefits instead of a spec sheet.
Labels are translation keys in the desktop app (PlanFeature.DisplayText
calls .Translate()), so changing one means re-running the translation
generator, which pulls these strings from /api/pricing/plans.php.
